sheet.name: Haunts of Utrebant

traits.name: Intangible
traits.text: Haunts of Utrebant ignore Terrain tiles for the purposes of both voluntary and involuntary movement, and Line of Sight.

traits.name: Ethereal Unity
traits.text:
! If any effect during the Delve instructed you to Escalate the BP deck, ignore that effect.

Each time a Haunt of Utrebant is removed from the Board, place a Generic token on this Trait. After you finish resolving the current action, if there are 3 or more tokens on this Trait, discard all tokens and Spawn three new Haunts of Utrebant. Draw three cards from the top of the Fool’s deck, and place new Haunts on the Board according to coordinates on the cards. If a Haunt were to Spawn on a space occupied by a Knight, instead place it on an unoccupied adjacent space. Assign Activation tokens starting from the left of the Mob track.

For every token on the Ethereal Unity Trait, all Haunts of Utrebant currently on the Clash Board gain the following bonuses:
1 token: +1 To Hit [To Hit].
2 tokens: All Attacks cause an additional -1 [Vigor] loss.
The effects of this Trait can stack.

traits.name: Spectral Step
traits.text:
Certain Zone Attacks include specially designated spaces on their diagrams. After performing a Zone Attack, the attacking Haunt will appear on that space.

If a Haunt were to appear on a space occupied by a Knight as a result of this Trait, that Knight suffers Unavoidable Knockback 3 and Crash. If a Haunt were to appear beyond a Board Edge, it appears adjacent to that Board Edge instead.

traits.name: Obscured Vision
traits.text: All Knights lose -2 Precision [Precision] when adjacent to a Ruined Wall Terrain tile.

traits.name: The Grim Gift
traits.text: During AI Escalation, always Escalate the lowest AI card from the AI deck or discard pile (prioritize the deck). This Trait takes precedence over regular Escalation rules.

traits.name: Revenge Served Ghastly Cold
traits.text: When you Spawn new Haunts of Utrebant, the leftmost Haunt performs Signature. Ignore during the first Monster Round.

traits.name: No Mercy
traits.text: Zone sizes of all Zone Judgments change from 1 to 2, and diagrams of all Zone Attacks increase in size as indicated by the yellow colored spaces on the diagram. If a Haunt of Utrebant moves onto a space occupied by a Knight at the end of a Zone Attack, that Knight dies!

facingDiagram.front: arrow below the mob token (pointing down)
facingDiagram.blindspots: none shown (R only, no eye icon)

sheet.levelsNote: Bonus row (blue): +N ribcage = AT bonus, +N V = Vigor Loss bonus. No starburst (Escalations) or die (Evasion dice) bonus icons are printed at any level, stored as 0. zoneDiagram.note: 9 columns x 6 rows. Haunt (single chevron, up) at bottom row centre (r6,c5); double chevron (up) at r2,c5. Red triangle: r3 c5; r4 c4–6; r5 c3–7 (9 cells). Yellow: r1 c5; r2 c4,c6; r3 c3,c4,c6,c7; r4 c2,c3,c7,c8; r5 c1,c2,c8,c9 (15 cells).

ai.text: PHANTOM FISSURE / ZONE ATTACK / Evasion 3 dice, 9+ / ZONE DIAGRAM (see zoneDiagram) / TARGETING: • [Priority Target] Priority Target • Closest Knight in front • Closest Knight in sight [REACT!] / MOVE & ATTACK / For each hit lose -4 [Vigor]. [Peril Check]. / AFTER ATTACK / Discard. Forced Vault. / HAUNTS OF UTREBANT – AI 3

_notes: Card codes are tiny pale print on 3x-upscaled crops; values are best readings reconciled with the run 27A1236–27A1253 (AI, six per level), 27A1254 (Signature), 28A1635–28A1643 (BP).
Icons: [Vigor], [Peril Check], [Heat], [d10], [Priority Target], [Precision], [To Hit], virtue icons [Bravery]/[Insight]/[Fortitude], [Curse] (glyph after the word Curse).
zoneDiagram.rows: see each legend. Single chevron = the Haunt; double chevron = Spectral Step destination space (sheet trait). Yellow cells are the Level-4 'No Mercy' enlargement.
Condition card names (Fear, Dread, Panicked, Slimed, Courage, Drowning) are printed in italics.
